title: The Last Lamp
text: A lamp burns in the dark with no one to tend it, a small brass thing on a stone, its flame steady. All around it, just beyond its light, the dark is pressing in, thick and cold and listening. As long as it burns, the dark stays back.

options.label: Carry the little lamp, and the dark with it, held at bay.

outcomes.text: The dark stays back as long as you have it, pressing, listening.

options.label: Each Scion feeds it a memory, so that it burns brighter.

outcomes.text: It burns brighter, and each of you is missing something, and none of you can say what.

options.label: Put it out. Whatever is in the dark, you would rather face it now.

outcomes.text: The dark comes in, all at once, and it has been waiting a very long time.
